name: Call of Water

angles.text: As a shaman, you seek the sapta by learning water's nature across different lands. You attune your spirit to its many forms.
As a dwarf, you hear Hervdana lament the division between the clans. Dark Iron dwarves press north as far as the Wetlands.

faq.answer: The sapta is a sacred draught that lets an initiate commune with elemental spirits. To earn it, an initiate seeks water in its many forms and learns how it shapes the land and nourishes life.
Hervdana guides initiates from her cave above the Wetlands waterfalls. She directs them to gather water samples and attune themselves to the element.
At the estuary, highland snowmelt and springwater meet ocean tides. Their waters carry sediment, minerals, and spiritual wisdom.
faq.q: Why gather water where the fresh meets the brackish?

aliases: why are dark iron dwarves here
faq.answer: Dangerous marsh creatures and Dark Iron dwarves threaten travelers near the waterfalls. The dwarves have pushed north into the Wetlands.
faq.q: What dangers lurk near the waterfalls?

faq.answer: A vessel is an initiate who seeks wisdom in the waters and carries offerings gathered from nature to deepen elemental harmony.
faq.q: What does it mean to become a vessel?

faq.answer: Hervdana provides the Empty Brown Waterskin to collect a brackish sample at the base of the waterfalls in the marsh.
faq.q: What is the Empty Brown Waterskin used for?

sections.body: Hervdana guides initiates through the search for water in its many forms. They learn how it moves, changes lives, and sustains the land. Their path toward the sapta and communion with the spirits begins at an estuary, where ocean tides meet fresh runoff from the highlands.
sections.title: The Way of the Sapta

sections.body: Below Hervdana's cave, waterfalls carry highland springwater into the marsh. There it meets saltwater pushed inland by the coastal tides. The ocean brings sediment, minerals, and energies unlike those in clear mountain snowmelt. An initiate can find wisdom in the land's natural ways where these waters meet.
sections.title: Where Fresh Meets Brackish

sections.body: Dangerous marsh creatures make gathering water risky. Dark Iron dwarves have also pushed far north into the Wetlands. Hervdana regrets the hostility between the dwarven clans. She sees how much dwarfkind might achieve if they set aside their feuds.
sections.title: Shadows in the Marsh

summary: In the Wetlands, an initiate gathers water to earn the sapta through Call of Water. The marsh is dangerous, but its waters show how water's energies shape and sustain the land.
